findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: data_quality_scorecard, browse_leads, quote_list, checkout_list, list_products, create_checkout · Private data: find_lead_by_glid, data_quality_scorecard, field_fill_rates, browse_leads, interpret_list, quote_list, list_starters, checkout_list, explain_concept, list_live_states, describe_surface, list_products, create_checkout · Public sink: data_quality_scorecard, field_fill_rates, browse_leads, quote_list, checkout_list, list_products, create_checkout · Destructive: data_quality_scorecard, browse_leads, quote_list, checkout_list, list_products, create_checkout.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: data_quality_scorecard, browse_leads, quote_list, checkout_list, list_products, create_checkout · Private data: find_lead_by_glid, data_quality_scorecard, field_fill_rates, browse_leads, interpret_list, quote_list, list_starters, checkout_list, explain_concept, list_live_states, describe_surface, list_products, create_checkout · Public sink: data_quality_scorecard, field_fill_rates, browse_leads, quote_list, checkout_list, list_products, create_checkout · Destructive: data_quality_scorecard, browse_leads, quote_list, checkout_list, list_products, create_checkout

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
